entities.name: UniProt Q5B0W8
observations: Reviewed Emericella nidulans leucine aminopeptidase 2; the supplied 618-aa sequence is an exact full-length match.
Preferentially cleaves di- and tripeptides; also shows low epoxide hydrolase activity in vitro.
Binds one Zn2+ ion per subunit; annotated to cytoplasm and nucleus.
Predicted sequence properties: 70,099 Da; theoretical pI 5.654.
